# Core RDS explorer, block builder (census #71, C16; kept: the vendor console takes a raw RDS
# location string, typed). static/pages/rds-explorer.js bbAddBlock -> bbGenerate -> sendRequest.

-- Add a block with no location
  (no request)
  toast info: Location is required
-- two blocks added: the rows drawn (bb-blocks)
  <span class="bb-detail">b1 &ndash; Load @ GRP-A-L1-S1</span>
  <span class="bb-detail">b9 &ndash; JackLoad @ LM<b>7</b></span>
  Pinned as is: the block id and the location go into the row unescaped (rds-explorer.js bbRenderBlocks).
-- Generate JSON (req-body):
  {
    "id": "T-1",
    "complete": true,
    "priority": 0,
    "blocks": [
      {
        "blockId": "b1",
        "location": "GRP-A-L1-S1",
        "binTask": "Load"
      },
      {
        "blockId": "b9",
        "location": "LM<b>7</b>",
        "operation": "JackLoad"
      }
    ]
  }
-- Send
  POST /api/fleet/proxy {"method":"POST","path":"/setOrder","body":"{\n  \"id\": \"T-1\",\n  \"complete\": true,\n  \"priority\": 0,\n  \"blocks\": [\n    {\n      \"blockId\": \"b1\",\n      \"location\": \"GRP-A-L1-S1\",\n      \"binTask\": \"Load\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"blockId\": \"b9\",\n      \"location\": \"LM<b>7</b>\",\n      \"operation\": \"JackLoad\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"}
